name: Brennstoffemissionshandel (nEHS) certificate price
law: BEHG § 10 (2): fixed price of 55 euro per certificate (one tonne of CO2) in 2025. Fuel suppliers buy a certificate for each tonne of CO2 their fuel emits and pass the cost on in the fuel price.

sources.title: BEHG § 10 (gesetze-im-internet.de, as the Internet Archive last kept it; the site times out to the workflow): fixed certificate prices to 2025 and the 2026 price corridor
